what: F1: Plan treats wrapper_rc=2 as an in-band first-fixer failure, but launcher exit 2 is the launcher die/argv-validation path before the fixer runs
scenario_or_breakage: This violates the stated policy that waterfall is skipped only when Cursor actually attempted the fix and failed non-health; a bad argv/plan/failure-log integration error would skip Codex/Claude and route to main-agent/user bail
suggested_fix: Do not classify bare wrapper_rc=2 as other; only short-circuit when the captured launcher KVs explicitly say LAUNCHER_FAILURE_CLASS=other, or define a separate integration/validation class that preserves existing fallback/stall behavior

what: F2: Plan requires binary-missing to be health but does not specify adding the binary-presence probe the new helper depends on
scenario_or_breakage: With cursor/codex/claude absent, the launch may surface as exit 127 or unknown; if classified as other, ship-pr skips the intended waterfall despite this being a health case
suggested_fix: Add an explicit command -v probe in each CI launcher before launch, pass that boolean/tool id to external_classify_launch_failure, and pin missing-binary tests in each direct CI launcher harness plus the helper harness

what: F3: Main-agent CI fix path says to commit via git-commit.sh but is silent on staging the edited files
scenario_or_breakage: git-commit.sh only stages positional file args; prompt-side edits are not staged automatically, so the new main-agent fix can run checks then fail to commit or push no fix
suggested_fix: Capture changed paths for the main-agent attempt, stage only those intended paths, then call scripts/git-commit.sh -m "Fix CI failure" -- <paths>; include a test/structure assertion for the staged commit sequence

what: F4: Main-agent CI fix push path omits the run-log refresh contract that existing CI-fix pushes use
scenario_or_breakage: Existing Trigger B refreshes token/timing/session-transcript logs before each CI-fix push; the new prompt-side fix path would push a CI-fix commit without the same log refresh, leaving merged run logs stale
suggested_fix: Add scripts/refresh-run-logs.sh --state-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" --implement-tmpdir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR" before git-push.sh in the new Step 8+ main-agent path, matching Trigger B semantics

what: F5: Test plan omits the existing SKILL structure harness that currently forbids main-agent CI repair prose
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed Step 8+ branch adds a main-agent CI-fix exception, but scripts/test-implement-structure.sh still has a negative check around main-agent Edit/Write wording and ship-pr.md says exit-code/state-key changes must update this test
suggested_fix: Update scripts/test-implement-structure.sh to pin the new first-fixer-non-health exception, sentinel/counter guard, same-argv foreground re-invocation, and continued prohibition for unrelated STALL_STEP=6 paths
